decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program builds directly on the firm's core psychiatric treatment expertise, so its multidisciplinary teams can interpret utilization and refine the program, which keeps the risk of withdrawal low.
Outpatient sociotherapy fits the firm's mental health and outpatient competence and can be improved from early case experience, though its modest website visibility leaves some risk.
Senior living counseling draws directly on the firm's eldercare knowledge, runs at low cost and has prominent strategic placement, so withdrawal is unlikely.

The retail shop extends the sheltered workshop's production but relies on retail knowledge further from the firm's care competence, and after the carpentry withdrawal it carries elevated risk while still being worth keeping.
Meal delivery for seniors builds on the firm's eldercare and kitchen operations, so it can learn from early demand, though it is new and only mentioned on the website.
